02 · The Founder

Florian Hurel

Founder & Creative Director. Celebrity hairstylist and founder of Florian Hurel Hair Couture & Spa, with ateliers across Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad and Hyderabad.

The Academy is where his session, salon and editorial practice is passed on, course by course, to the next generation of hair professionals.

“Beauty is not a transaction, but a transformation, composed one visit at a time.”
03 · The Collection

Seven courses

Every course runs hands-on with daily model work. 2027 dates and entry requirements are confirmed by the Academy at enrolment.

01/ 07

Salon Intensive Cut & Colour

Duration3 days
Price₹30,000
Dates 2027At enrolment

A focused programme for working hairdressers who want to sharpen cutting and colouring in one stretch. You build precise, repeatable cutting methods and a solid grasp of colour, then practise them on models every day so the skills carry straight back to the salon floor.

  • Precision cutting and colouring techniques
  • Creative cutting: disconnection, freehand and modern sectioning
  • Colour chart theory
  • Total, partial and combination colour techniques
  • Demonstrations plus daily hands-on work sessions

For qualified or experienced hairdressers who want the skills to excel in a competitive salon.

Express Colour

Duration3 days
Price₹25,000
Dates 2027At enrolment

A short, fast course on colour that works in a busy salon. You learn quick highlighting and balayage methods that give natural depth and a soft blend without long appointments, so a great result fits inside a tight booking.

  • Highlighting and modern balayage techniques
  • Precision foil placement for rapid highlighting
  • Seamless balayage blending
  • Dimensional, multi-tonal effects done quickly
  • Techniques for a fast-paced salon

For hair professionals expanding their skill set.

Texture / Updos

Duration3 days
Price₹20,000
Dates 2027At enrolment

A course on working confidently with wavy and curly hair, and finishing it as an updo. You learn how texture changes cutting, balance and shape, and how to section, pin and finish an updo that respects natural movement.

  • Mastery of textured hair
  • Modern ways of working with naturally wavy and curly hair
  • Precision techniques combined with collection techniques
  • Modern balances and proportions
  • Updos: sectioning, pinning and finishing, with hands-on practice

For hairdressers who want confidence with textured hair and occasion styling.

Learn how hair is created for the camera. You see how a look is planned and styled for a shoot, how to work with a team on set, and how salon skills adapt to images. You finish with a photograph of your own work.

  • Practical styling combined with image-making

Barbering

Duration3 days
Price₹25,000
Dates 2027At enrolment

A practical course in modern barbering that gives short hair, fades and finishing the same care as long hair. You learn to blend with clippers and scissors, shape for each client's head and hair type, and finish with a clean, confident style.

  • Inclusive, gender-neutral barbering for all hair types
  • Precision cutting
  • Fading with scissors and clippers together
  • Advanced styling techniques
  • Classic barbering principles: suitability, control and finish

For hairdressers and barbers of all experience levels. In-person, hands-on training with expert guidance.

05 · The Experience

Three days. Models daily. Mastery by doing.

The same format runs across the collection: watch it done, do it yourself, refine it with the team.

01

Demonstrations

Each topic opens with the educators working live on models: the thinking, the sectioning, the finish, explained as it happens.

02

Daily model work

You practise on models every day of the course, repeating each technique until it is precise, repeatable and your own.

03

Guidance throughout

Small groups and an open format mean direct time with the creative team, with questions welcome at every stage.

07 · Questions

Good to know

How long are the courses?

Three days each, hands-on with daily model work. Collection by FH runs two days: day one preparation, day two the collection.

When are the 2027 dates?

Dates are confirmed by the Academy at enrolment. Collection by FH runs in March 2027.

Do I need experience?

It depends on the course. Salon Intensive asks for qualified or experienced hairdressers, Collection by FH is for advanced learners, Barbering welcomes all levels, and the Self Grooming Class is open to everyone.

How much do the courses cost?

Between ₹10,000 and ₹2,50,000 per person, per the course list above.

Which course is right for me?

Tell the Academy team your experience and goals at enquiry, and they will help you choose.

How do I enquire?

Through the Florian Hurel Hair Couture & Spa website or Instagram, linked below. The team replies with dates and next steps.
